name: Clement Town (Campus & Tibetan Area)
character: Zero-travel, 1–2 h trips. Peaceful monasteries, towering stupa, authentic Tibetan cafes.

name: Rajpur Road & Malsi Stretch
character: Cafe-hopping, rooftop bars, nightlife, and the gateway corridor ascending to Mussoorie.

name: City Center & FRI Heritage
character: Paltan Bazaar, colonial Forest Research Institute, Clock Tower bakeries and markets.

name: East Doon Streams & Springs
character: Robber's Cave (Gucchupani) and Sahastradhara. Nature, river walking and canyon streams.

name: Mussoorie Road & Approach
character: Winding mountain highway with scenic roadside Maggi/tea viewpoints, Mussoorie Lake, and Jharipani.

name: Mussoorie Town & Mall Road
character: Library Chowk, Mall Road, Gun Hill cable car, and Camel's Back sunset promenade.

name: Landour Heritage Ridge
character: Lal Tibba highest viewpoint, Char Dukan, Landour Bakehouse, Sisters' Bazaar, St Paul's.

name: Park Estate & George Everest
character: Sir George Everest's House, Hathipaon, Wish Well, 360° Himalayan panoramas.

name: Extended Valley & Foothills
character: Full-day standalone expeditions: Bhadraj Trek (11 km) and Rishikesh (42 km).
